subject.title: Adopt noUncheckedIndexedAccess via a ratchet lane (phase 1: eight small packages)

question: Should phase 1 include the new @openclaw/normalization-core/expect export, or remain limited to compiler/lint wiring and local behavior-preserving fixes?
rationale: The ratchet is bounded internal test infrastructure, but the helper export is a lasting cross-package API whose ownership and necessity cannot be inferred safely from the proposal alone.

options.title: Pilot ratchet only
options.body: Add the scoped compiler and lint lane, fix the eight packages locally, and revisit a shared helper only if repeated patterns prove it reduces complexity.

options.title: Approve shared helpers
options.body: Include expectDefined, first, and last as an intentional normalization-core API with explicit owner review and focused contract tests.

recommendation.title: Pilot ratchet only
recommendation.body: Add the scoped compiler and lint lane, fix the eight packages locally, and revisit a shared helper only if repeated patterns prove it reduces complexity.
